parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper opener handle of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, small in size, and located at the top front.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to open the top compartment or lid of the trashcan to dispose of waste easily.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pull outward depending on the hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower opener handle of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, located below the upper opener.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to open the lower compartment, possibly for accessing a secondary bin or storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It can tilt or swing outward when pulled.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This is an outer frame component of the trashcan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a decorative and protective outer layer for the trashcan’s front section.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: Another outer frame section of the trashcan, made of ABS plastic, located on the side or lower front.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity and aesthetic continuity to the trashcan’s body.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, forming the container’s primary structure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the waste bin and provides overall stability and durability to the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and supports all other parts.
